provider_query: The first YouTube video, Me at the zoo
answer:
**“Me at the zoo”** is widely recognized as the first video uploaded to YouTube.

1. **Upload** — Posted April 23, 2005 (about 8:27–8:31 p.m. PDT) by YouTube co-founder **Jawed Karim** on the channel “jawed.” It is still his only upload.  
   [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo) [[2]](https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo)

2. **Content** — A roughly 19-second (often called 18–19s), low-resolution clip filmed by high school friend **Yakov Lapitsky** at the **San Diego Zoo**. Karim stands in front of two elephants and says they have “really, really, really long… trunks, and that’s cool.”  
   [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo) [[3]](https://www.tubefilter.com/2025/04/23/20-years-youtube-me-at-the-zoo-2005-jawed-karim/amp/)

3. **Link** — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw  
   [[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw)

4. **Views** — Hundreds of millions of views (reports around the 20th anniversary cited ~355–386 million; later page snapshots show higher, on the order of 440+ million).  
   [[3]](https://www.tubefilter.com/2025/04/23/20-years-youtube-me-at-the-zoo-2005-jawed-karim/amp/) [[5]](https://www.star-telegram.com/entertainment/article315252892.html) [[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw)

5. **Why it exists** — Karim, Steve Chen, and Chad Hurley (ex-PayPal) built YouTube so ordinary people could share video easily. Karim has said difficulty finding clips online (including the 2004 Super Bowl wardrobe malfunction) helped inspire the idea. The zoo clip was an early platform test.  
   [[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dcZY3yi8Xbw) [[7]](https://applescoop.org/story/history-of-youtube-me-at-the-zoo-to-tv-giant)

6. **Legacy** — Often called YouTube’s first vlog and a milestone of user-generated video. *The New York Observer* and *BuzzFeed News* have ranked it among the most important online videos. The San Diego Zoo later commented that it was honored the first video was filmed there.  
   [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo) [[2]](https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo)

7. **Description edits** — Karim has changed the description over time to comment on platform policy (e.g., Google+ comments in 2013; dislike-count removal in 2021).  
   [[8]](https://www.the-sun.com/tech/14087057/youtube-first-video-me-at-the-zoo-google-karim/) [[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw)

8. **Wikipedia entry** — Concise overview of upload date, location, speakers, and historical significance.  
   https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo  
   [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo)
